Title: Hermeiou Sozomenou Ekklesiastike Historia. Sozomeni Ecclesiastica Historia, edidit Robertus Hussey. Tomus II (books V-IX)
Creator: Sozomen (Salamanes Hermeias Sozomenos, c. 400-c. 450); Robert Hussey (ed.), with the Latin version
Publisher: Oxonii: e Typographeo Academico
Publication Date: 1860 (archive.org catalogue date; the title page is garbled in this OCR, which renders its Latin as Greek-looking glyphs, and only the author's name survives legibly at file line 79)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1860); the item record carries no rights field
Language: grc (Greek text recovered, 987,000 Greek characters; the Latin version and the Latin title page are garbled into Greek-looking glyphs throughout this OCR, so only the Greek is usable)
Source: archive.org item sozomeniecclesia02sozo (University of Illinois copy; catalogue volume 2 of three), full text at https://archive.org/download/sozomeniecclesia02sozo/sozomeniecclesia02sozo_djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-10-17 by the Shared-Events source-research thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (2,703,462) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt. Editor, place and year are taken from the archive.org record, which names Hussey, Oxford, 1860, and describes the set as volumes 1-2 Greek text with Latin translation, volume 3 annotations.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: an 1860 Oxford printing is out of US copyright under this project's pd-us-by-date rule. SCAN QUALITY: second witness. The Greek is legible but carries stray accent characters on separate lines; the Latin is not recovered. Verify against the page image before quoting.
Content note: Hussey's Oxford Greek text of Sozomen, volume II: Book V opens the volume, Book VI begins at file line 7206, Book VII at file line 18760, Book VIII at file line 26089 and Book IX at file line 33141. Book VII carries the Council of Constantinople of 381 (Nectarius's election at file line 20181; Maximus the Cynic at file line 20332); Book VIII carries Theophilus, the Tall Brothers, Epiphanius at Constantinople and the Synod of the Oak ('eis Dryn', file line 30387), with Innocent's letters in Greek translation. Greek original behind the English of npnf202_socrates-sozomen-ecclesiastical-histories.xml. A near-contemporary Constantinopolitan narrative written about 440-450, not an eyewitness. Hussey's volume III (notes) is not vendored.
